description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_set: when update_object returns NotFound, the handler falls through to create_object to create the singleton, then calls update_object again. Two concurrent requests hitting this path simultaneously both receive NotFound, both call create_object, and the comment acknowledges this: 'Backends MUST make create_object idempotent for the singleton key'. That requirement is in a handler comment, not in the backend trait doc. A new backend implementor will not see this requirement on MailBackend::create_object and will create a non-idempotent implementation. The requirement must be in the trait method's doc comment.
title: VacationResponse/set upsert races: two requests can both create the singleton
